title: Row filters don't apply to an administrator, whatever other roles the user has

source.quote: Row filters don't apply. All data can be queried in this role.
source.supports: the Administrator permission sees all the data

source.quote: When a user is a member of multiple roles, the permissions defined for each role are cumulative.
source.supports: the administrator's permission adds to Europe's

derivation: Admins has the Administrator permission: all five sales, 210. Europe's filter takes nothing away (permissions are cumulative).
